name: Mika Anderson
source:
A quiet girl in her senior year of high school. At the start of the game, she inherits the estate of her recently passed grandfather and as a result meets the incubi, who drastically change her life.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1730112593/seduce-me-an-otome-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
